responsibility: Implements the AVX-512 BITALG+VL intrinsic header for 128-bit and 256-bit byte/word bit-algorithm operations while explicitly selecting non-EVEX512 code generation. It provides the VL-sized masked popcount APIs for bytes and words and the `bitshuffle_epi64_mask` operations that produce mask registers from packed byte inputs, serving as the narrow-width companion to the full AVX-512 BITALG header.
